title: Area-code shard C pass 20 — 575 / 602 / 605

data.research_question: Which current public organizations, public organizational actors, affiliations and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 575, 602, and 605?
data.method: Current NANPA membership and deterministic NPA mod 3 == 2 selection; literal and locality-derived public web searches; first-party/current-status verification; historical-directory leads treated only as seeds; repository dedupe; public-person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational participation, public representation, attendance, residence or volunteering.
Do not merge organizations or people from similar names or handles alone.
Directly stated and inferred person-org relations must remain distinguishable; this pass retained only directly stated person-org relations.
Area-code locality association is not a claim that an organization publishes a telephone number in that NPA unless separately evidenced.

findings.notes: Food Not Bombs Las Cruces and Las Cruces Community Action Network retained. Dylan Davis is directly identified as an FNB Las Cruces volunteer in April 2026. Historical FNB directory material was not used as active-status proof.

Food Not Bombs PHX retained as current; existing canonical Mutual Aid Phoenix org and investigation target reused. Current public handles include @PHXFNB and @mutualaidphx. Jonathan Bowerstock and Jeremy Peraza are explicitly identified FNB volunteers; Parris Wallace is explicitly identified as a Mutual Aid Phoenix founder.

Sioux Falls Mutual Aid and West River Tenants United retained. Seymour Otterman and Serene Reinholz are explicitly identified co-organizers; Rachel Funk self-publishes a 2026 fundraising coordinator role. No sufficiently stable current named WRTU representative was found in the bounded pass.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 575, 602, and 605.
